# Investment, guidance & growth: building successful companies

At Technology Venture Partners, we’re driven to transform unique, high-potential technology companies into successful businesses and market leaders. Our focus on growth-equity investments allows us to use our financial expertise, industry knowledge, and strategic insight to guide entrepreneurs and company leaders into positions of **strength**.

## A portfolio poised for success

We strategically invest in technology companies with unique market opportunities that are at an inflection point and positioned for rapid growth.


# 7SIGNAL, Inc.

Cleveland, Ohio-based company offering an enterprise-software Wi-Fi network monitoring and mitigation platform dedicated to helping businesses and organizations foster thriving connections and experiences.

# Ampion, Inc.

Boston, Massachusetts-based leader in software and services supporting the rapidly growing marketplace for distributed generation of renewable energy.

# BrightView Technologies, Inc.

Durham, North Carolina-based leader in the design and manufacture of micro-lens arrays on large-format films, creating custom optical products to efficiently manage and manipulate light for display, 3-D sensing, and lighting applications.

# Revinova, Inc.

Massachusetts-based company whose Digital Academy software platform provides knowledge-rich learning environments for prospects and customers. Embedded academies are the natural pathway for customers to navigate themselves through a curated buying funnel, leading to stronger prospect engagement that generates a highly qualified buyer.
